## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `08c9d61fe83e707f6f726d50da82e01a1c4b4ece`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Read from the net diff `origin/main...08c9d61fe83e707f6f726d50da82e01a1c4b4ece` (31 files), card #36931 and all 5 comments, and PR #37084's body and file list. The diff changes these accept-sets and public surfaces:

1. **`@object-ui/types` `ActionResult.paused?: { runId: string }`** (`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`, published, 18.6.0). This is a new optional member beside #36915's `refusal`. A handler may now write one more key, and a reader may see one more key. No value accepted today is refused, and no existing member changes type or meaning. Its doc says when it is set (only beside `success: true` and `handedOff: true`) and that `runId` is `''` when the engine sent none. **Judged right: a widening.**
2. **What the console's flow launch now returns** (`app-shell/src/utils/flowLaunch.ts`). `withRefusal` became `withHandOffVerdict`. Every launch that pauses at a screen now carries `paused`, including a single-record click, not only bulk runs. This changes runtime output, not a type. The emitter is in `@object-ui/app-shell`, which is `private: true`. The seven in-repo pins that compared a paused result with `toEqual` were updated, and their runner assertions are unchanged. `ActionRunner` reads only `success` and `handedOff` (core `ActionRunner.ts:2329-2346`), so a hop or `onSuccess` behaves as before. **Judged right: additive, with no published consumer to break.**
3. **`BulkResult.paused?`, the new `BulkRowPause`, `BulkProgress.paused: number` (required), and `BulkRecordVerdict` changed from an interface to a two-arm union** (`plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`). If these were public, two would matter. A required member on `BulkProgress` would narrow what a caller may construct. A union cannot be `extends`-ed, as the interface could. None of them is exported: `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` exports `BulkActionBar`, `useBulkActionItems`, `CHANGE_OWNER_BULK_ACTION`, `resolveBulkActions` and the types `BulkActionBarProps`, `BulkActionItems`, `LegacyBulkActionItem`, `ActionLabelResolver` and `NamedActionDef`, and none of those reaches the executor's types. Their only consumers are `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `BulkActionDialog.tsx`, both in the same package. **Judged right: the package's own internals, with no published accept-set change.** The documented invariant `succeeded + failed + refused.length + paused.length === total` holds on the run path and on both retry arms.
4. **`ObjectGrid` per-record bulk behaviour** (`plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:2936`). `res.paused` now resolves `{ paused: true }`, so the row is counted as waiting, not as succeeded. This is published runtime behaviour. It is reachable only when a handler sets the new optional member, and a third-party handler that never sets it sees no change. **Judged right.** One side effect of this behaviour is not contract-level; it is graded in the L1 notes as should-fix S1.
5. **`@object-ui/i18n`**: two keys, `grid.bulk.resultPaused` and `grid.bulk.pausedRecords`, in every locale pack file under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/`. There are eleven: ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans and zh-Hant. None is missing either key. The PR's word "ten" either undercounts by one or leaves out zh-Hant because it is generated. Either way, nothing is missing. The exported `TranslationKeys = typeof en` (declared `as const`) gains two members. That is additive, as every key addition is. `resultPaused` is registered as count-neutral in `count-families-11445.test.ts`, beside `resultRefused`, which has the same shape (a label followed by `{{count}}`, with no plural form). **Judged right.**
6. **`useScreenFlowQueue`, `QueuedScreenFlow`, `ScreenFlowQueue`** are new, and both `FlowRunner` mounts are now keyed per queued run. All of this is in the private `@object-ui/app-shell`, so there is no published surface. **Judged right.**

The card's acceptance asks two things:
- **It reuses #36915's typed signal and adds a `BulkResult` category beside `refused`.** Met: the `ActionResult` member sits beside `refusal`, `BulkRecordVerdict` gains an arm, and `BulkResult.paused` sits beside `refused`. No second mechanism is added.
- **A three-row bulk run in which two rows pause is pinned.** Met by `useConsoleActionRuntime.bulkPausedScreens-36931.test.tsx`, which asserts "Succeeded 1 / 3", "Waiting for input 2", that Ann and Cy are listed, that both screens are reached in turn, and that none is left after the last. It has a one-pause control. The PR states the shape it chose ("one after another"), as the card asks.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset**: `.changeset/36931-bulk-flow-paused-rows.md` names `'@object-ui/types'`, `'@object-ui/plugin-grid'`, `'@object-ui/app-shell'` and `'@object-ui/i18n'`, all at `patch`. Those are exactly the four packages the diff moves. `app-shell` is private, and listing it follows the sibling #36961 (`.changeset/36915-bulk-flow-refused-count.md`, also at the root `.changeset/`, whose config names the `@object-ui/*` packages).
- **`Clause-②: yes`**: correct. The diff widens a published surface (`ActionResult.paused`) and narrows nothing. The PR body says "What is widened … Nothing existing is narrowed", and the changeset body says the same. No arm is written, and an absent arm reads as `yes` with no direction. That is legal (`clause2-line.mjs` `CLAUSE2_ARMS`: "The arm is OPTIONAL"). `yes (widening)` would only say the same thing explicitly.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`**: correct. `ActionResult` is a runtime TypeScript interface. It is not an authorable metadata key, value or type, so no metadata author can write anything new or different.
- **Level `patch`**: correct. AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3) says "the level follows the kind alone … `none` takes **`patch`**; a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`". The older line in the `clause2-line.mjs` docblock, "`yes` / `yes (widening)` … both take at least `minor`", predates ruling A, and AGENTS.md overrides it. That docblock is outside this diff and is not a finding here.
- **Line form**: both declarations stand alone at column 0 in the PR body and in the changeset body. They are not quoted, bulleted or backticked. `CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE` and `METADATA_PROTOCOL_KEY_LINE` therefore read them as `declared` with the values `yes` and `none`; this was read from the parser source and not executed. `Check Changeset` on this head is **success** (both runs, the second at 19:47:07Z).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags and `open_questions`**:
  - The blocked report (comment 7141327999) raised two questions. Q1 was how the branch reaches GitHub. It was answered when the push was allowed and PR #37084 opened. Q2 was whether the File surface could grow to cover the i18n packs and `count-families-11445.test.ts`. It was answered when the seat amended the claim at 2026-11-24T19:01Z (claim comment 7139427891). Every diff path is inside the amended surface.
  - The final report (comment 7141735464) has `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none` and `out_of_scope_findings: []`.
- **NOT MEASURED locally**: three gates were flagged. CI ran each of them on this head, and each passed:
  - `check:query-options-erasure`: the `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure` job is success.
  - `check:type-check-debt`: the `Type Check · debt ledger` job is success.
  - `check-i18n-en-drift` (blocked report): `ci.yml:4038`, in the `Type Check UI` job, which is success. That job also runs `check:i18n-keys`, the key gate that the missing keys had turned red before the amendment.
- **Check-runs on this head**: every completed required job is success. That covers Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI (all 16 shards), Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, every Lint and Type Check job, Check Changeset, the Governed Surface Queue Guard and Check PR Size. The rest are skipped as opt-in or queue-only. The first `PR-body guards` run (job 138705835373) failed with exit 3 while reading the board. That was infrastructure, judged so in PR comment 7142495950. Its re-run, job 138727094309, is **success**.
- **Disclosed behaviour**: the PR says that screens of paused records open over the bulk dialog while the run continues. A single paused record already behaved this way, so the diff adds no new boundary.
- **SQL push-down**: n/a. The diff materialises no ids and adds no in-app join. The per-record fan-out over the client-side selection already existed, and the executor only sorts ids it already holds into one more category.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `08c9d61fe83e707f6f726d50da82e01a1c4b4ece` · 2026-11-24T19:56Z

Card #36931. Beside the contract review at this head (declaration face, TIER_DEFAULT): PASS, no must-fix, no should-fix.

Delivered and correct, read against the code: the queue keys each paused run and `settle(key)` drops only that entry; both `FlowRunner` mounts remount per run; `succeeded + failed + refused + paused === total` holds per batch and after a retry that pauses; paused rows stay out of Retry and the error CSV; related counts are invalidated when a row paused; both new keys are in all eleven locale files. The `PR-body guards` failure was the board read (exit 3); its re-run passed.

S1 (should-fix) — a run in which EVERY row pauses keeps the selection and does not refresh the grid. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `handleBulkDialogClose`: it resets the selection and bumps `refreshKey` only on `succeeded > 0` (or an aggregate refusal). Before this PR the same run read "Succeeded 3 / 3" and did both, so this is a regression for the common all-paused case: the grid stays stale after steps before the screen may have written (the reason the executor invalidates counts), and the armed selection invites the second run the PR denies Retry to avoid. Fix: treat `result.paused.length > 0` like a success in that handler (reset the selection and refresh). Pin it: an all-paused run closes with the selection cleared and the grid re-read; ablate the new condition.
S2 (should-fix) — settle-by-key has no pin. The PR's reason for keying `settle` is the record-link path (close first, complete later), but a regression to "settle drops the head" passes every current test. Add one pin: two queued runs, the first a result screen dismissed through its record link; the second screen still opens. Ablate `settle` to drop the head; the pin goes red.

Nits, fix while there (prose and ordering only): N1 screens open in dispatch-finish order while the dialog lists selection order — say so in the PR body or open them in selection order; N2 a row moved to `paused` by retry is appended though `BulkResult.paused` is documented as selection order (`useBulkExecutor.ts`, the retry arm) — insert in order or fix the doc comment; N3 `refusedRecordName` now also names paused rows (`BulkActionDialog.tsx`) — rename; N4 the PR body says "ten packs", eleven locale files carry the keys.
